items.question: How is a fractional share of the bounty rounded when the hidden-test share doesn't divide it evenly?
items.ticket: record a partial release of the configured hidden-test share (default 75%)
items.chose: Rounds the hidden-test part down with BigInt integer division, so the remainder goes to the UAT release.
items.instead: Round to nearest, or round the hidden-test part up.

items.question: What unit and type is the bounty in, and what happens when it is negative, fractional or too large?
items.chose: Requires a safe integer of at least 0 (minor units) and throws RangeError otherwise.
items.instead: Accept decimal amounts, or accept any non-negative number without a safe-integer limit.

items.question: What happens when the configured hidden-test share is out of range or not a whole number of basis points?
items.chose: Throws RangeError unless the share is an integer from 0 to 10000 bps.
items.instead: Clamp the share to the range, or fall back to the 75% default.

items.question: When does an invalid task (bad bounty or share) get rejected?
items.chose: Throws immediately when the handler is created, not when an event is handled.
items.instead: Validate lazily and reject the handle() call.

items.question: What does a bounty of 0 do?
items.chose: Reports status "pro bono" and records releases of amount 0. The status never becomes "fully released".
items.instead: Skip releases for a zero bounty and report "fully released" or "locked".

items.question: What happens when UAT is approved before the hidden tests have passed?
items.chose: Rejects with an Error and stores nothing.
items.instead: Release the whole bounty on UAT approval, or ignore the event.

items.question: What happens when the hidden tests pass again after the first release (a duplicate or new event)?
items.chose: Ignores any later pass event once a hidden-tests release exists, whatever its id. It returns the current state and writes nothing.
items.instead: Return an error, or dedupe only by event id.

items.question: What happens when UAT is approved a second time?
items.ticket: Remaining balance is released exactly once
items.chose: Silently returns the current state with no new release.
items.instead: Reject with an error on the repeat approval.

items.question: How is the UAT release amount computed?
items.chose: Releases the bounty minus the sum of earlier releases, rather than the stored split's uat value.

items.question: What happens when a hidden-test run fails?
items.chose: Returns the current state without writing to the store. If a later run passes, it can still release.
items.instead: Record the failure in state or lock the task after a failure.

items.question: How are concurrent events, including events through different handlers on the same store, handled?
items.chose: Runs events one at a time through a per-store promise queue, and the queue keeps going after a failure.
items.instead: No serialization, or a lock or compare-and-set in the store.

items.question: What happens on an unknown event kind, or a store write failure?
items.chose: Throws for an unknown kind. A store error rejects the call and nothing is recorded, so the event can be retried.
items.instead: Ignore unknown events, or swallow store errors and retry internally.
